title: FlapLab Daily — Winless in Six.exe
story: You are Michael Carrick. Man United's worst start in 40 years just got another draw at Elland Road. The Leeds crests keep marching on together — keep your head down and flap.
inspiration: FT Leeds 1-1 Man United at Elland Road, 18 Oct 2026 (Mbeumo 35', Calvert-Lewin 51') — United winless in six across competitions, 7 points from 7, 13th; 'Carrick out?' replies everywhere. X Trending 'Carrick' + 'Leeds Draw 1-1 with Manchester United' (x.com/i/trending/2111182358661537901). Carrick photo (Wikimedia, Apr 2025) cut with rembg; Leeds United crest (en.wikipedia) stacked; Elland Road 'Marching On Together' stand (Wikimedia, 2023).
